title: Close out self-describing project publications (Design 65)
description: Complete the existing Design 65 worktree change. Validate descriptor-authoritative run/test/install, unchanged-build reuse, malformed-cache recovery, failed-build preservation, main/argument behavior, Git plus native closure, and relocation. Add repeatable launch timing and record before/after evidence. Run Rust workspace, project smoke, Birnam module suites, and source-build/cold-archive gates. Update design and changelog with observed acceptance; do not publish a release.
close_reason: Design 65 publication closeout complete. Expanded project smoke passed; mise verify passed Rust workspace, native lifecycle and two independent cold archives; module suite 611/611. Removed duplicate preflight and application dependency from test discovery; build reports reuse. Nine-module Git/native launch median 1.228479s to 0.826210s (32.7% improvement). Durable evidence and reproducible script in Design 65. No release qualification or user-prefix deployment.

title: Research and document stackless throughput recovery
description: After publication closeout, measure current loop/callback behavior and inspect execution, frame, and dispatch costs. Compare with retained v0.14 evidence without treating historical timings as current. Produce a repo-native plan with ranked hypotheses, bounded implementation slices, semantic/lifecycle gates, reproducible commands and follow-up Beads coverage. This task authorizes research and documentation, not throughput implementation.
